note: Ownership map as structured data. concepts preserves app concept -> owner doc (+ allowed referencers), with owner/reference paths relative to docs/. owners is the scaffold surface inventory, with paths relative to the repo root. Holds NO code anchors (path -> symbol) -- those are Layer B, they live inside the docs themselves and feed the separate freshness/certification ledger (Layer C). Ownership answers 'who owns this concept'; it does not track code. The prose guidance ('edit the owner; link, don't redefine') is GENERIC and lives in the global authoring-rules.
